svg.title: Genesis / Bulk ATAC-seq
svg.desc: Paired-end plant libraries, explicit analysis choices and separate biological replicates.. Arrows show selected data dependencies; this is not a live execution graph.
svg.text: Paired-end plant libraries, explicit analysis choices and separate biological replicates.
Adapters, MAPQ and duplicate handling are explicit. Plant quality thresholds remain unspecified.
Peaks use unshifted fragments; cut-site tracks use Tn5 offsets. Selected dependencies are shown.
